warnings: The sheet's own drawing title is 'แปลนเสา คาน พื้น' while the title block reads 'แปลนคาน, พื้นชั้น 1' — one combined column/beam/slab plan, one view. Classified beam_plan (beams with marks and grid endpoints dominate; slab tags and unlabeled column squares ride along), matching house 14's precedent for the same combined-sheet situation.

Column positions are drawn (hatched squares at the 8 main-grid intersections) but not labeled on this sheet — the column mark C1 is printed only on the footing plan S-02, so columns are recorded there, not here.

B1 is a short interior beam on the ridge/wall line 1'' from B to B'; both of its ends land on beams (B3 at row B and B3 at row B'), not on columns — flagged bears_on_beam per §5. The B' interior beam line (B3 1→2, B2 2→3) likewise has both ends bearing on the grid-1/2/3 vertical beams, not on columns.

Slab markers: SP = precast solid plank (arrow on plan shows planks spanning the x direction), S1 = ห้องน้ำ cast-in-place slab, S2 = deck slab, S0 = stair-landing slab (ดูขยาย F2). Recorded one entry per mark with the marked areas listed in grid_refs.
บันไดไม้ดูแบบสถาปัตยกรรม — the wooden stair south of row C between the landing and the deck is architectural (no structural members drawn) and is deliberately not an element here.
